scripts.test: uv run pytest -q && npm --prefix web test -- --run
scripts.check: uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm test
scripts.gen-types: uv run python -c "import json; from api.main import app; print(json.dumps(app.openapi(), indent=1))" > web/openapi.json && npm --prefix web run gen-types
